FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Helpful information before your cleaning and checkup.

Ready to book?

Our team can help you find a time that works.

Contact Us
How often should I have a dental checkup?

Many people benefit from a visit every six months, but your dentist can suggest a schedule based on your needs.

Will a cleaning hurt?

Professional cleanings are usually comfortable. Let your hygienist know if your teeth or gums feel sensitive.

How long does a checkup take?

It depends on the care you need. We’ll explain the plan and timing when you arrive.

What should I bring to my appointment?

Bring any relevant health or insurance information and a list of questions you’d like to discuss.
